title: Introduction to UNICEDE/2
text:
Introduction to 
UNICEDE
/2

UNICEDE
/2 allows primary insurers and their treaty reinsurers to exchange aggregate sums insured, risk count, payroll, premium, and other appropriate data in a format that can be easily imported. 

UNICEDE
/2 files can be used to import aggregated
 exposure data into 
Touchstone Re
. The standard
 supports country-specific lines of business and geographic detail.

Refer to the following topics for more information:
